title: Data Integrity and Stewardship Cluster
summary: DISC is a University of Malta research cluster working on research data governance and stewardship. It brings biomedical imaging researchers together with specialists in law and other disciplines.

Claude Bajada is Vice-Chair and leads the biomedical imaging pillar. Mireille-Martine Sant chairs the cluster. Their joint work examines how researchers can share neuroimaging data while meeting data protection requirements.
TARRAGON and OSIRIS-EU are projects within DISC. The cluster also supports specific outputs from other projects, including data governance for the SiGn phantom dataset.
